 Vandals to Host Rolling Hills Rival Eagles in Battle for the Che-Scow Cup
 Story Links
 Watch (ESPN+/SWX) 
 Listen (Varsity) 
 Live Stats 
 Idaho Game Notes 
 Tickets 
 Idaho (4-5) vs Eastern Washington (2-7) 
 P1FCU Kibbie Dome | Moscow, ID 
 2:00 PM PT - Kickoff on ESPN+/SWX 
 Listen: Vandal Football Radio Network | The Varsity Network App (Dennis Patchin and Trent Cowan) 
 Live Stats 
 2026 Football Record Book 
 MOSCOW, Idaho - " The games they remember are played in November. "
One of the oldest adages in college football will ring true for Idaho Football, a team coming off of an October heater in which they won four of five outings, including the last three straight.
Now the Vandals are set to host the closest rival in terms of proximity in the Big Sky Conference, bringing Eastern Washington to Moscow for the battle of the Che-Scow Cup, looking to bring the hardware back to the Gem State for the first time in two seasons. 
Idaho's series with Eastern Washington is one of the more storied in the history of both programs, with UI holding a 20-10 advantage in the all-time series and taking home the most recent victory two seasons ago. The Vandals put up 267 yards and three scores on the ground, largely due to Deshaun Buchanan and Art Williams combining for 176 and two of those, respectively. 
A win over the Eagles will only further the Vandals' quest for a late-season playoff push and cement the first four-game win streak for Idaho since the 2024 campaign, when the Black and Gold won five straight to finish the regular season and followed that up with a playoff rout of Lehigh in the P1FCU Kibbie Dome.
 HEAR FROM THE COACHING STAFF
A LOOK AT EASTERN WASHINGTON 
Eastern Washington's 2-7 record is not remotely indicative of the team making the trip to the P1FCU Kibbie Dome on Saturday, as while Idaho is one of the only teams in the FCS with more than one win over a top-10 team, the Eagles have a win over another one of those teams. 
In Week 2, EWU welcomed Northern Iowa to Roos Field in a non-conference matchup, taking down the Panthers, 34-24 in early September. UNI has since gone on to record wins over then #3 Illinois State and #4 North Dakota, the former of which came off a national championship berth in 2025. The Eagles have since picked up a Homecoming win over Northern Colorado, and most recently took #12/13 Montana to the wire, overcoming 11 surrendered sacks to nearly knock off the Griz. 
The face of the team by a large margin is fourth-year QB Nate Bell, who has tossed nearly 2,500 yards and 19 TDs while also leading the team in rushing with 384 yards and another eight scores. Wesley Garrett and Drew Carlson have been Bell's favorite targets to date, combining for 82 catches, 995 yards, and seven TDs with nearly even splits between. Outside of the signal caller, Kevin Allen III and Jaxon Bell have each accounted for north of 220 yards rushing on the season. 
Defensively, Eastern Washington is surrendering just over 38.5 PPG, but fifth year linebacker Myles Mayovsky is racking up tackles at an impressive clip, totaling 82 in nine outings. Additionally, the defense has had success taking the ball away. Federal Way product Jaylon Jenkins has snagged three picks, while Jojo Maxey-Johnson, Ambrose Marsh, and Bryce Smith have earned two apiece. 
 THINGS TO LOOK FOR 
 Saturday's contest will return to the weekly tradition of games with a regional broadcast or better for Idaho, being featured on ESPN+ and SWX. UI opened the year with back-to-back national broadcasts at Cal Poly on ESPN and at Utah on ESPNU.
 The Vandals have a total of ten contests in 2026 to be shown on SWX, Scripps Sports, Rose City Sportsnet, or linear ESPN.
 Idaho's offense has put up strong numbers, especially against FCS competition. In the season opener vs. Cal Poly, the Vandals put up 482 yards of total offense in Ian Shoemaker's OC debut, more than any game last season and the most since a 38-28 win over Eastern Washington in 2024 (487). 
 The Black and Gold recorded a season-high 496 yards of total offense vs. Weber State
 Vs. FCS competition, Idaho is averaging over 437 yards of offense per game.
 Joshua Wood has been one of the best at moving the ball in the Big Sky, averaging north of 276 passing yards per contest while collecting 9 rushing scores, the latter being second-most among conference QBs.
 The Vandal defense has been stout in crunch time, holding two top-ten teams in Lamar and Montana State to a combined 13 points in the second half.
 NUMBERS TO KNOW 
 1: To kick off October, Idaho secured its first-ever win over the #1 team in the country, knocking off defending national champions Montana State in Moscow. The win not only gave UI the first of the season, but ended the Bobcats' 19-game winning streak dating back to September of 2025.
 4 : As of publication, Idaho is one of just four FCS teams, the others being Northern Iowa, South Dakota State, and Youngstown State, to have recorded two wins over teams ranked in the top-10. 
 88: Idaho's win over Montana returned the Little Brown Stein to Moscow for the first time since 2022. Originally commissioned 88 years ago in 1938, it is the oldest active trophy in the FCS. 
 1989: This season, Idaho recorded victories over both Montana and Montana State, marking the first Treasure State season sweep for the Vandals since 1989.
 3: Idaho is one of three FCS teams to record multiple wins over FBS programs since 2023 (Idaho beat Nevada 33-6 in 2023, Idaho beat Wyoming 17-13 in 2024)
 17: This past offseason, the Vandals celebrated the highest-ranked recruiting class in program history and the second-best '25 class in the FCS, bringing in a total of 17 three-star prospects.
 8: Number of FBS, Preseason Top 25 FCS, and teams that received ranked votes that Idaho plays this year.
 3: Idaho's strength of schedule rating per Massey, out of 128 FCS teams.
 10: Ten of Idaho's twelve regular-season contests have received a regional or national broadcast assignment. The Vandals will face Cal Poly and Montana State on ESPN and Utah on ESPNU, while Lamar, Abilene Christian, Southern Utah, Eastern Washington, and UC Davis have all been picked up by SWX, and the Battle of the Little Brown Stein with Montana will be broadcast on Scripps Sports. The Halloween contest with Portland State was also simulcast on Rose City Sportsnet.
 34: Idaho scored 34 points against Cal Poly in Week 1, the third-highest total in a season opener since 2015.
 The Black and Gold are averaging nearly 33 points a game vs. FCS teams.
 83: The Vandals boast a veteran offensive line with four of five 2025 starters returning, each of whom has started games prior as well. Layton Vining , Charlie Vliem , Kiegan Henson , and Leon Evans have combined for 83 career starts coming into 2026.
 TRADITIONS 
Idaho football is continuing the tradition of the Vandal March. Every home game, the football team and coaches will kick off the opening of the Vandal Fan Zone by walking through the crowd and greeting fans as they make their way into the Dome before the game starts. This will take place approximately two and a half hours before kickoff. The Vandal Fan Zone will open at this time as well.
Saturday's action will also be a blackout, and Vandal fans are encouraged to dress in black to showcase their school pride and make the P1FCU Kibbie Dome one of the best home-field advantages in the west.
 SOCIAL MEDIA: Follow the Vandals on Facebook , Instagram , and X for the latest updates.
 TICKETS: Single game tickets for Eastern Washington and UC Davis are on sale now. Follow this link to secure your seats.
